resources.string: Each mode uses its own prompts to read the board. Tap the floating ball after switching to analyze with the new mode.
The vision model reads the whole screenshot; the text model picks among the legal moves. DeepSeek by default; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.
1. Pick a game mode above, then tap "Start floating ball".
2. Grant the overlay and screen-capture permissions when asked.
3. Open the game and tap the floating ball once to analyze the board.
4. The card shows the recognized board and the suggestion; check it before you act.
5. Tap "New game" on the card to clear the previous game memory.

Tap the floating ball to run its current mode long-press for menu
Used for the volume-key shortcut and for taking screenshots while the card assistant runs. The screen is captured only when an analysis is triggered.
Press and hold the highlighted ball for about one second until the arc menu opens. Do not tap—the tour continues only after a real long press. After the tour, tap runs %1$s and drag moves the ball.
The floating-ball walkthrough will close. To run it again, restart the floating-ball service from the home screen.
You’ve seen every floating-ball action. Long-press the main ball to reopen the menu at any time.
Switches the main ball to loop translation. Tap the main ball afterward to start or stop repeated translation.
Changes the screenshot area without leaving the current app.
Quickly changes the source and target languages used for translation.
Switches between saved OCR, translation, language, TTS, and display presets.
Opens the full settings screen for detailed configuration.
Runs one board analysis: captures the screen, sends it to your configured vision model, and shows the suggestion card.
Returns to the Card Assistant home screen.
Switches the main ball to word-select translation. Tap the main ball afterward, then drag a box around the text to translate.
Switches the main ball to full-screen translation. Tap the main ball afterward to capture and translate the configured area.
Switches the main ball to Input Translation. Tap it afterward to translate the text in the current input field.
When the actions do not fit on one page, use this ball to open the next group. Tap “Show next page” to continue the tour there.
This is also the paging ball. On the last page, it cycles back to the first group.
Double tap to translate the current input field. Long press to open the menu

In Input Translation mode:
Tap: translate the text in the current input field.
Double tap: run %1$s.
You can change the double-tap action in Settings.
